leaseWizard.discardDescription: Your lease draft will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
leaseWizard.placeholderStep: Step {{step}} — form fields will appear in the next tasks.
leaseWizard.finalStepHint: Review your entries, then download a PDF or save to your CRM.

complete.summary: Download a summary PDF for signing, or save the lease to your account when property and tenant are linked in steps 1–2.
complete.linkHint: To save in the CRM, link a saved property in step 1 and a saved tenant in step 2.
complete.savedWithPdf: Lease saved. PDF is attached to the record.
complete.savedButPdfFailed: Lease saved — PDF could not be attached
complete.savedButPdfFailedDescription: You can upload a PDF from the contract detail page, or use Download PDF from the wizard if you still have the draft.
complete.validationFailed: Fix the highlighted fields, then try again.
complete.linkRequired: Link a property (step 1) and tenant (step 2) before saving.

step1.heading: Property
step1.description: Where the rental is located and basic unit details. Link an existing listing or enter the address manually.
step1.loadPropertyError: Could not load that property. Try again or enter the address manually.
step1.yearBuiltHelp: Required for federal lead-based paint disclosure rules (pre-1978 homes).
step1.timezoneReadonly: Timezone used for this lease: {{iana}} — {{label}}. It updates when you change the state.

step2.heading: Parties
step2.description: Landlord, tenants who sign the lease, additional occupants, and optional co-signer or guarantor.
step2.tenant2Helper: Jointly liable tenants should each sign. Add a second named tenant when applicable.
step2.occupantsHelper: People living there who are not lease signers (no signature block on the PDF).
step2.coSignerHelper: A co-signer or guarantor should have their own signature block on the lease.
step2.coSignerRoleBanner: Co-signer: signs the lease and is responsible with the tenants from day one. Guarantor: typically liable only if the tenant defaults (follow your state and office policy).

step3.heading: Lease term
step3.description: Choose a fixed term or month-to-month tenancy, then set dates and notice rules.
step3.endDateHelpStandard: Must be after the start date by at least one full month.
step3.endDateHelpM2m: Optional document end date for your records; tenancy continues month-to-month until notice.
step3.terminationNoticeHelp: How many days’ notice either party must give to end a month-to-month lease (check your state law).
step3.durationBadgeSubtitle: Updates when dates change (fixed term only).
step3.durationInvalid: Enter a valid start and end date to see the length.

step4.heading: Financials
step4.description: Rent, deposits, fees, and one-time charges. Amount due at signing is an estimate you can refine later.
step4.rentDueDayHelp: Day of the month rent is due (1–31).
step4.otherDepositHelp: Separate from the security deposit — e.g. keys or non-refundable fees if applicable.
step4.securityHelp: Often one month’s rent; return timing depends on state law.
step4.securityReturnHelp: Default 21 days — verify your state’s requirement.
step4.nsfHelp: Many states cap these fees — confirm locally.
step4.earlyToggle: Tenant moves in before lease start
step4.parkingNote: Ongoing monthly parking is billed with rent — it is not part of “amount due at signing” below.
step4.signingTotalHelp: Adds first month’s rent, optional deposits, early move-in, prepaid rent, and pet deposit (if you allow pets in a later step).
step4.parkingExcluded: Monthly parking is excluded from this signing total.

step5.heading: Payment & utilities
step5.description: How rent is paid and which utilities the landlord covers.
step5.paymentHelp: Select at least one. If you pick digital options, add the details below.
step5.utilitiesHelp: Check what the landlord covers; tenants typically pay the rest unless noted in the lease.

step6.heading: Property details
step6.description: Furnishings, appliances, shared spaces, parking, and move-in inspection.
step6.commonAreasDescription: Describe shared spaces and access rules
step6.parkingHelp: On-site or assigned parking included with the unit.
step6.inspectionHelp: A walkthrough checklist helps document condition at move-in.

step7.heading: Policies
step7.description: Pets, subletting, renters insurance, and smoking rules.

subletting.noRestriction: No restriction (follow state and office policy)

step8.heading: Notices & disclosures
step8.description: Where to send legal notices, federal lead-based paint rules, and any extra lease clauses.
step8.noticesHelp: Override mailing addresses for formal notices if they differ from the addresses already entered. Leave blank to use landlord and property addresses from earlier steps.
step8.leadBannerRequired: Complete the lead-based paint disclosure below. It is required for most pre-1978 housing, when year built is unknown, or when you include disclosure for newer homes.
step8.leadBannerOptional: For homes built in 1978 or later, disclosure is optional unless you turn it on below.
step8.leadDisclosureToggle: Include lead-based paint disclosure in this lease
step8.knownHazardsHelp: Answer based on your knowledge and any seller or prior-landlord disclosures.
step8.recordsAvailable: Records or reports on lead-based paint
step8.pamphletSection: Protect Your Family from Lead in Your Home (EPA pamphlet)
step8.additionalTermsHelp: Optional clauses not covered above (house rules, storage, etc.). Keep language consistent with your broker and state law.

purchaseWizard.title: New purchase agreement
purchaseWizard.draftNeedsLogin: Sign in to save a draft.
purchaseWizard.discardDescription: Your purchase draft will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
purchaseWizard.placeholderStep: Step {{step}} — form fields will appear in the next tasks.

step1.heading: Property
step1.description: Subject property for this purchase: link a saved listing or enter the legal address and details.
step1.loadPropertyError: Could not load that property. Try again or enter the address manually.
step1.wrongPropertyType: Only sale listings can be linked here. Pick a sale property or enter the address manually.
step1.condoMineralBanner: For condominiums, mineral rights are typically not transferred with the unit. The agreement will default mineral rights to “No” in a later step.
step1.taxParcelHelp: Also known as APN (Assessor’s Parcel Number). Format varies by county — enter as shown on county records.
step1.landIncludedHelp: Most agreements include land. A condominium or apartment typically does not.
step1.otherPropertyInfoQuestion: Additional property details beyond the address?
step1.otherPropertyInfoPlaceholder: e.g. The total land area is 2 acres.
step1.yearBuiltHelp: Used for federal lead-based paint disclosure rules (pre-1978 homes).
step1.timezoneReadonly: Timezone used for closing and notices: {{iana}} — {{label}}. It updates when you change the state.

step2.heading: Parties
step2.description: Buyers and sellers who will sign, optional co-buyer and co-seller, how title will vest, listing agents, and the agreement effective date.
step2.wrongLeadType: Only sale leads can be linked as the buyer.
step2.linkLeadHelp: Prefills name and contact from your pipeline. Mailing address can be completed below.
step2.addCoBuyerHelp: Two buyers who will sign separately. Title vesting is required when there are two buyers.
step2.titleTypeHelp: Required when two buyers sign. Choose the option that matches your closing attorney or title company advice.

titleTypes.ticHelp: Each owner holds a separate share (can be unequal). No right of survivorship.
titleTypes.jointHelp: Equal shares with right of survivorship (all four unities required).
titleTypes.entiretyHelp: Married couples only — strongest survivorship protection in states that recognize it.

step2.addCoSellerHelp: A second seller who will sign separately (for example a co-owner on title).
step2.effectiveDateHelp: The date this offer or agreement is intended to take effect.

step3.heading: Personal property
step3.description: List fixtures and personal property included in the purchase price (appliances, window treatments, smart home devices, etc.). Leave blank if none apply.
step3.label: Fixtures and personal property included
step3.help: Be specific enough to avoid disputes at walkthrough. Examples: refrigerator, washer and dryer, mounted TV brackets.
step3.placeholder: e.g. Refrigerator, dishwasher, garage door opener, window blinds throughout living areas…
step3.pdfNote: If this section is empty, the generated summary PDF will show “None specified” for personal property.

step4.heading: Earnest money
step4.description: How much earnest money is offered, when it is due, and whether it must be held in escrow.
step4.infoTitle: How earnest money is usually treated
step4.infoBody: Earnest money is typically credited toward the purchase price at closing. If the buyer defaults without a valid contingency, the seller may keep it as liquidated damages under your state contract — confirm with your broker or attorney.
step4.amountHelp: Use whole dollars. VA loans may allow $0; other loans may require a minimum.
step4.deadlineTimeHelp: Local time at the property on the due date (e.g. 5:00 PM).
step4.escrowRequired: Must earnest money be held in escrow?
step4.escrowHelp: Many states and lenders require an escrow or title company to hold deposits.

step5.heading: Price and financing
step5.description: Select the financing path and complete only the fields required for that path.

allCash.sellerRejectWindow: Seller has 3 business days to reject proof of funds.

bank.fhaWarningBody: FHA loans require a signed Amendatory Clause BEFORE the appraisal is ordered. RealDesk does not generate this form. You must upload it in Step 9 to complete this agreement.
bank.vaWarningBody: VA loans require a VA Escape Clause (38 CFR § 36.4303). RealDesk does not generate this form. You must upload it in Step 9. Earnest money can be $0 for VA loans.
bank.sellerTerminationDays: Seller has X days to terminate if letter not received
bank.contingentOnSale: Contingent on sale of another property?

seller.rateTooltip: RealDesk does not calculate amortization schedules. Use a mortgage calculator for monthly payment estimates.
seller.docDeadline: Buyer provides documents to seller by

step6.heading: Closing
step6.description: Set closing costs, closing date/time, and title company details.
step6.closingDateNote: Must be after inspection deadline (set in Step 7).
step6.titleCompanyPlaceholder: To be agreed upon by the Parties
step6.fundsBody: Accepted forms of payment at closing: cash, wire transfer, money order, certified check, or cashier's check. Personal checks are NOT accepted at closing.

step7.heading: Conditions and contingencies
step7.description: Define survey, title, inspection, and appraisal timelines.
step7.surveyBuyerDays: Buyer must notify seller of survey issues within X days before closing
step7.surveySellerDays: Seller has X days to remedy survey defects
step7.condoAutoBanner: Mineral rights are typically not transferred with condominium units. This has been set to No automatically.
step7.titleBuyerDays: Buyer has X days after receiving Title Search Report to object
step7.titleSellerDays: Seller has X days to correct title defects
step7.inspectionContractorDateHelp: Buyer may hire licensed contractors until this date.
step7.inspectionDisclosuresDate: Buyer must present new disclosures by
step7.inspectionNegotiationDays: Both parties have X business days to resolve disclosures
step7.appraisalNegotiationDays: If appraisal comes in under purchase price, parties have X days to negotiate
step7.activeContingenciesNote: Review contingency dates carefully — missing a deadline may result in forfeiture of earnest money.

step8.heading: Legal terms and defaults
step8.description: Set expiration, governing law, and default terms.
step8.offerExpirationDateHelp: Agreement is revoked if Seller has not signed by this date.
step8.offerExpirationDateOrderError: Offer expiration must be on or before the closing date.
step8.governingLawHelp: This state's laws govern interpretation of this agreement.
step8.earnestMoneyReturnDays: If terminated without default, return earnest money within X business days

buyerDefault.title: Buyer Default
buyerDefault.body: If Buyer defaults, Seller's remedy is limited to retaining the Earnest Money as liquidated damages. Seller waives all other claims.

sellerDefault.title: Seller Default
sellerDefault.body: If Seller defaults, Buyer may cancel this agreement and recover the Earnest Money in full, or seek specific performance.

disputeResolution.title: Dispute Resolution
disputeResolution.body: Any disputes shall first be submitted to mediation. If mediation fails, disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration. Each party bears their own mediation costs equally.

step9.heading: Disclosures and final review
step9.description: Complete required disclosures, addendum uploads, and review all prior steps.
step9.agentsNote: Agent compensation per separate written agreement.
step9.leadPaintRequiredBody: FEDERAL LAW REQUIRES lead paint disclosure for this property (42 U.S.C. § 4852d). This section cannot be skipped.
step9.leadPaintNotRequired: Property built 1978 or later - lead paint disclosure not required.
step9.knownHazardsNo: Seller has no knowledge of lead-based paint or hazards
step9.knownHazardsYes: Seller knows of lead-based paint or hazards
step9.pamphletDelivered: I confirm the EPA pamphlet 'Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home' was delivered to the buyer(s).
step9.leadPaintPurchaseNote: Federal law grants the buyer a 10-day opportunity to conduct a risk assessment or inspection for lead hazards before being obligated under this contract. Buyer may waive this right in writing.

addenda.title: FHA / VA Addendum Upload
addenda.saveFirst: Save agreement first to upload addenda.
addenda.fhaHelp: This clause must be signed BEFORE the appraisal is ordered. The agreement cannot be marked complete without this document.
addenda.vaHelp: VA loans require this clause. Buyer may cancel and recover earnest money if VA appraisal is below purchase price.

warningDialog.title: FHA/VA addendum not uploaded
warningDialog.description: FHA/VA addendum not uploaded. Your agreement will be marked incomplete until you upload it from the deal detail page. Continue anyway?
